note: Scope mirrors the UC-APP-005 dependency-contract and API delivery work package. Domain, UseCase, MongoDB decision persistence, the Auth Developer Status consumer, immutable App Center-local policy repository, URL preflight adapter, System Auth ID configuration, API transport and consumer E2E are implemented. Reviewer permissions use the compatible permissions claim added to trusted-identity-v1. Remaining production-equivalence work is the platform internal-service identity and Auth allowlist, the reviewer grant/revoke lifecycle and SYSTEM principal provisioning, then a production-identity double-service E2E. ADR-001 covers approval-time Scope Catalog revalidation; ADR-006 and the shared routing contract cover the formal Proto/API boundary. Cross-cutting ADRs (003/004/005) remain in the engineering baseline.
